description: An individual human person, alive or dead. This is used for artists or other creators, current staff and researchers, and anyone else.

Name.description: Link to the reified Name collection.

Identifier.description: Link to the reified Identifier collection.

Contact Point.description: Link to the reified Contact Point collection.

Equivalent.description: This field is used to document a URI which is meant to indicate an equivalence between the documented person and a resolvable, structured reference resource that stands as a document for this self same entity.

Type.description: Link to the reified Type collection.

Gender.description: Link to the reified Gender collection.

Nationality.description: Link to the reified Nationality collection.

Ethnicity.description: Link to the reified Ethnicity collection.

Birth.description: Link to the reified Birth collection.

Death.description: Link to the reified Death collection.

Family Relations.description: Link to the reified Family Relations collection.

Occupation.description: Link to the reified Occupation collection.

Member of Group.description: This field is used to link the documented person to a broader group of which it is a member / forms a part.

Statement.description: Link to the reified Statement collection.

Depicting Image.description: This field  is used to record the existence of an image which depicts the documented person.

Digital Reference.description: Link to the reified Digital Reference collection.

Source Reference.description: Link to the reified Source Reference collection.

Languages.description: This field is used to record language(s) known by the documented person.

Social Relation Status Target.description: This field is used to link the documented person to another actor, in relation to whom it holds the social relation status attributed to it.

Created Text.description: The linguistic object that was created by the person, representing a textual or symbolic expression produced through their intellectual activity.

Exercise Role of Type.description: This field is used to record the role played by an person in an activity with typified roles.
